title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.6 (Peaked October 06, 2026 at 15:06 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 426 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G2 Predicted

Still keeping an eye on that earlier M1.8 flare. 👀💥✨

Several bright active regions stand out in today’s solar images, while no clear outward CME is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
